_THE_EXISTING_TGI_PAGE_IS_WRONG: Our live page calls Found Golf 'a tight five-piece lineup' and 'Melbourne's Found Golf'.
Both are wrong. The brand is SOUTH AFRICAN BORN and Melbourne based, splits its
operation between Melbourne and Cape Town, manufactures in Cape Town, designed its
first collection while based in LONDON, and carries far more than five pieces —
tops, bottoms, knitwear and headwear collections, plus an art-and-design practice
and a consultancy arm. The page also states AUD prices with no read date, which
breaks the house rule. It must be rebuilt, not patched.

story.brand_self_description: An independent Melbourne based brand that is more than just fashion, we activate golf as a creative culture through clothing, art, design and storytelling. We are the curated clever that looks to the future and paves a way for establishment reform.

quotes._source: Good Sport Magazine interview, published on found.golf 29 April 2024, campaign photographed by Kent Andreasen. https://found.golf/blogs/articles/good-sport-magazine-interviews-found
quotes._rule: VERBATIM ONLY. Attribute to the named founder where the interview names them, and to 'Found' where the interview answers as the brand.

verified.text: I am obsessed with it all. Connecting with the challenge against yourself. The surroundings, the sounds, and out of bounds.
Now that I finally have clothes to wear, I am really getting into it! For now, I'm still on par 3 courses, but the bug has bitten.
It's a lifestyle, not a sport. Golf should be the same.
Mainly that you can dress like a skater (even if you can't skate) because you aspire to the culture or to be a part of the movement.
When I first really started obsessing over golf, I was confused at the obvious conformity in what everyone was wearing and how disconnected that was from modern fashion trends.
verified._note: Interview renders this as 'When I (Lance) first really started...'. The parenthetical is the magazine's attribution device, not Lance's words — quote it without the interpolation, attributed to Lance.

verified.text: the only negative is the old school holding onto the wrong traditions and the new school ignoring the right traditions.
verified._note: STRONGEST LINE IN THE INTERVIEW. Candidate for the big pull-quote.

verified.text: Tight joggers and 1500 private jets at The Masters.
verified._note: Answer to 'What do you find tasteless about the mainstream world of Golf?' — reads as punching at the sport's excesses, not at another brand, so it clears the never-talk-down rule. Check with Lenny before using.

verified.text: In Cape Town, freedom is a way of being (think mountain hikes and less rules). For Melburnians, freedom is self expression
